unsupported: This hub is too old to configure models here. Update the hub first.
intro: Each feature uses these settings the next time it runs; tasks already working aren't interrupted. Manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
schedule_default: Scheduled tasks use the main chat's model configuration by default.
execution_headless: Answers through a background process on the selected computer, without a terminal panel. Runs in the assistant's working directory using the launcher's environment and Claude/Codex configuration directory, which the launcher may override. Choose a launcher available on that computer or a Messages provider. Used for the main chat and scheduled tasks.
execution_engine: Opens an interactive agent in the target computer's terminal host. Uses that computer's selected host (such as herdr or Orca), terminal environment and launcher configuration directory. The host is a computer setting, not a provider setting. Choose an available launcher or a Messages provider. Used for new agents.
lark_headless_inheritance: Inherits the Agents model · Runs as a background process
execution_api: The assistant sends HTTP requests directly, without a local agent process, terminal environment or Claude/Codex configuration directory. Connections and credentials come from Model providers. Supports Messages, Responses and Chat. Used for information processing, screening, answering agents' questions and extensions' model calls.
execution_plugin: The extension's own model service handles requests using its environment, configuration and credentials, without starting a Persona agent process. Only models offered by the extension are available. Typically used for voice services.
execution_unverified: Unverified means this launcher hasn't been confirmed to run on the target computer. It doesn't mean a model call succeeded or failed.
no_purposes: The hub has no model uses to configure yet
saved: Saved; applies from the next run
conflict: The configuration was changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reload, then edit and save again.
effective_footer: A use's settings take priority over the defaults; a one-off choice in a session or task can still override them.
picker_hint_provider: Default uses this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit: Default leaves it unset, so it follows the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_provider_machine: Default uses this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit_machine: Default leaves it unset, so it follows the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
field_hint: Leave empty to follow the level above. A model ID you type isn't tested, so it may not work.
save_note: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks.
save_note_plugin: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks. The voice model is Persona's default choice and doesn't change the extension's own provider or credentials.
runtime_hint: The Agent SDK needs Node 22+ on that computer; without it the CLI is used
supervise_description: Follows up and reviews the tasks Persona hands out, so the main chat stays free to answer you. It can run on a cheaper or a stronger model than the main chat.
